title: Inclusive electron-nucleus cross section models from domain adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08463v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We apply transfer learning (TL) to construct data-driven models of inclusive electron-nucleus cross sections. Starting from an ensemble of deep neural networks pretrained on \(^{12}\)C data, we fine-tune the models separately for \(^{3}\)He, \(^{6}\)Li, \(^{16}\)O, \(^{27}\)Al, \(^{40}\)Ca, and \(^{56}\)Fe. The resulting models improve for all targets, marginally so for oxygen, where the carbon baseline is already adequate, although their predictive robustness depends on the amount, coverage, and precision of the available target data. We systematically study how model performance depends on the number of fine-tuned layers, on the fraction and selection of the training data, and on the overlap between the source and target kinematic domains. translated_title: 基于域自适应的包容性电子-原子核截面模型
translated_abstract: 我们应用迁移学习（TL）构建了数据驱动的包容性电子-原子核截面模型。从在碳-12（\(^{12}\)C）数据上预训练的深度神经网络集合出发，我们分别对氦-3（\(^{3}\)He）、锂-6（\(^{6}\)Li）、氧-16（\(^{16}\)O）、铝-27（\(^{27}\)Al）、钙-40（\(^{40}\)Ca）和铁-56（\(^{56}\)Fe）的模型进行了微调。所得模型对所有目标核都有改进，对于氧核改进幅度较小，因为碳基线模型已经足够充分，尽管其预测的稳健性取决于可用目标数据的数量、覆盖范围和精度。我们系统地研究了模型性能如何依赖于微调的层数、训练数据的比例和选择方式，以及源域和目标域运动学范围之间的重叠程度。逐层分析表明，氧核只需要浅层自适应，而氦、钙和铁则需要更深入的微调。锂是最不稳健的情况……
tldr: 该研究利用迁移学习将基于碳-12数据预训练的深度神经网络适配到氦-3、锂-6、氧-16、铝-27、钙-40和铁-56等多种原子核的包容性电子散射截面建模中，发现不同核所需的微调深度各异，且模型预测稳健性依赖于目标数据的数量、覆盖范围和精度。
en_tdlr: This study applies transfer learning to adapt deep neural networks pretrained on carbon-12 data to model inclusive electron-nucleus cross sections for He-3, Li-6, O-16, Al-27, Ca-40, and Fe-56, showing that different nuclei require different fine-tuning depths and that predictive robustness depends on the amount, coverage, and precision of the available target data.
